title: Using Collective Dialogues and AI to Find Common Ground Between Israeli and Palestinian Peacebuilders
reasoning: The paper is a case study on using LLMs to facilitate dialogue and identify shared societal values (e.g., peace, equality, human life) between conflicting groups. It does not benchmark or evaluate the religious, moral, or ethical systems of the AI model itself; rather, it uses the AI as a tool for distilling human consensus.
